Name: CyeraDSPM
Author: Cyera DSPM OCTO Team - support@cyera.io
Description: The [Cyera DSPM](https://api.cyera.io/) data connector allows you to connect to your Cyera DSPM tenant and ingest Classifications, Assets, Issues, and Identity Resources/Definitions into Microsoft Sentinel. It is built on Microsoft Sentinel's Codeless Connector Framework and uses the Cyera API to fetch [DSPM Telemetry](https://www.cyera.com/). Once received, the data can be correlated with security events and used to create custom columns so that queries don't need to parse it again, resulting in better performance.
